headline: See asset risk early enough to plan the right review
capabilities: Predict failures with real-time analysis and automated planning
Automate permit tracking and renewals with intelligent workflows
Generate audit-ready reports quickly with streamlined data collection
Consolidate fragmented data into real-time insights for easy centralized monitoring
outcomes: Improved asset reliability, reducing unplanned downtime and costs
Maintained compliance and operational continuity across facilities
Streamlined compliance reporting and minimized audit risk
Gained real-time visibility and strategic planning support to achieve emissions goals
why_try: A plant manager can ask one natural question, see the exact asset driving modeled risk, and carry a bounded recommendation into engineering and finance review.

sample_prompts.label: Plant Manager: Wind farm risk analysis
sample_prompts.prompt: I need immediate analysis on our wind farm turbines

sample_prompts.label: Reliability Engineer: Turbine condition triage
sample_prompts.prompt: Show me the weakest turbine condition and whether this is an operating authorization.

sample_prompts.label: Finance Business Partner: Maintenance budget planning
sample_prompts.prompt: What maintenance funding should I reserve for the at-risk turbines?

sample_prompts.label: Maintenance Planner: Bundled maintenance plan
sample_prompts.prompt: Draft the bundled maintenance plan for the at-risk turbines, but do not create any work orders.

business_flow: Plant managers, reliability engineers, maintenance planners, and finance partners
